description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing 'CorrectiveAction' entities, including custom query methods for retrieving actions by defect ID and counting by status and due date.

classes.name: CorrectiveActionRepository
classes.description: A JPA repository interface for 'CorrectiveAction' entities, providing methods to find and count corrective actions based on various criteria.

methods.name: findByDefectId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CorrectiveAction entities associated with a specific defect ID.

methods.name: countByStatus
methods.description: Counts the number of CorrectiveAction entities with a specific status.

methods.name: countByStatusNotAndDueDateBefore
methods.description: Counts the number of CorrectiveAction entities with a status different from the specified one and a due date before the given date.
